rule: Manufacturer data, standards and technical claims must be verified against the original source and stored with retrieval date.

source_classes.manufacturer: Primary source: official tooling/material manufacturer documentation.
source_classes.standard: Primary source: applicable standards body or licensed standard text.
source_classes.technical_literature: Secondary source: engineering literature or university/technical references.
source_classes.internal: Local catalog/calculation data; never presented as manufacturer-certified unless sourced.
